story: Common Space is a mini food hall that brings together a curated selection of top food and beverage (F&B) brands under one roof. It offers a diverse range of dining options, from breakfast to dinner, and everything in between. Customers can enjoy a variety of cuisines all in one convenient location.

The food hall features a mix of established and up-and-coming F&B brands, each offering their own unique menu and atmosphere. The space is designed to be welcoming and comfortable, with plenty of seating options, and a lively atmosphere that encourages socializing and community building.

Common Space is open from sunrise till sunset, making it the perfect destination for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and even late-night snacking. Customers can start their day with a fresh cup of coffee and a pastry, enjoy a leisurely lunch with friends, and end the day with a delicious dinner and a glass of wine.

In addition to the dining options, the mini food hall also features a variety of drink options including beer, wine, cocktails, and non-alcoholic beverages. The atmosphere is perfect for casual dining, and there’s something for everyone, whether you’re looking for a quick bite or a leisurely meal.

story: Dancing Fish is an award-winning contemporary Malay-Indo restaurant that serves up authentic traditional dishes. With their ethos of offering traditional Malay-Indo delicacies with flair, Dancing Fish’s dishes are a fusion of old and new, combining age-old recipes and fresh modern techniques to bring a whole new dimension of flavour to traditional cooking methods. Since its establishment in 2009, the restaurant has been lauded with award after award for its outstanding food and environment.

Its unique food concept offers a contemporary twist to traditional village dishes. From starters to mains, Dancing Fish brings traditional recipes to life using modern techniques. The restaurant’s signature dishes are cooked from scratch on a daily basis to preserve the homemade flavour – a refreshing change from mass food production. The menu consists of a delicious selection of wholesome meats, fresh vegetables and moreish rice dishes with each plate crafted with care and quality ingredients.

Dancing Fish’s unpretentious yet stylish ambience, coupled with its delicious dishes in generous portions, offer diners an outstanding dining experience. Dancing Fish’s creative approach to local staples, as well as their commitment to using top quality raw ingredients cooked in traditional methods, has not only proven itself the talk of foodies in town but also among tourists who yearn to taste an authentic slice of Malaysia. Indeed, this commitment to quality has not gone unrecognised; Dancing Fish has been named a MICHELIN Selected restaurant from 2023-2026.

fangkong.tagline: Fang Kong Live Music Bar (放空 Live Music Bar)
story: Fang Kong is a live music bar in Kota Damansara with an indoor capacity of 700 pax and an outdoor capacity of 150 pax, all fitted in a whopping 13,000 square foot area, spanning two floors with a terrace and balcony. Fang Kong was founded and named after a Cantonese phrase that translates to “spacing out”. We know for a fact that anyone who wants to space out after a hectic week at work. One would definitely want a place where they can enjoy some live music, be it acoustic or a tribute band, whilst gulping down bucket of beers with your buddies. Fang Kong is exactly that place.

Our menu? We’ve got comfort food and we’ve got Asian food. That is not all; you can also enjoy Spanish tapas, Western Food, Thai, Chinese and Malay food. We’re sure that you will have a ball of a time hanging out at Fang Kong.

Our first-class sound system provides the best audio for live performances and most importantly, our strong live music lineup for the whole week. Every Monday to Thursday starting 9:30pm and Friday-Sunday starting from 6pm, we have acoustic sessions at balcony, and tribute bands downstairs.

story: Paperkite Chicken & Beer is all about one thing: chicken done right. From wings to tenders and everything in between, it all leads back to the star of our menu — the CB Original Recipe Chicken. Crafted with a secret blend of handpicked herbs and spices, it’s crunchy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and the reason people keep coming back for more.

Pair that mouthwatering chicken with freshly brewed, award-winning craft beers from Malaysia’s own Paperkite Brewing Co. Brewed to pair with our bold flavours, each pint is crafted with care, character, and zero shortcuts. Together, they deliver the kind of food-and-beer combo that keeps the vibe going — a standout experience for anyone who loves great chicken, great beer, and a place that doesn’t hold back.

rama-v.tagline: A Timeless Sanctuary in the Heart of Kuala Lumpur
story: A hidden sanctuary in the heart of Kuala Lumpur, Rama V has been redefining Thai dining since 1995. Set within a charming stand-alone bungalow, it offers an oasis of calm where authentic Thai flavours meet modern elegance.

From the elegant main dining hall to private chalets and the serene Fa-Ying Garden, every space is thoughtfully designed for intimate occasions — from romantic dinners and corporate gatherings to weddings.

Guided by a philosophy of affordable luxury, Rama V combines timeless Thai traditions with contemporary touches, delivering warm hospitality and culinary excellence that have made it a beloved destination for three decades.

tap-room.tagline: Malaysia’s Premier Craft Beer Microbrewery Experience Centre
story: Tap Room KL is a unique dining and entertainment destination that brings together the best of craft beer and delicious food. The venue is home to Malaysia’s own craft beer brand, PAPERKITE, and offers a wide variety of modern contemporary inspired flavors of tapas to complement the beer. With a seating capacity of 500, the venue is perfect for both small and large groups.

One of the highlights of Tap Room KL is the Pizza Duo, which serves great Neapolitan pizzas with a modern twist, straight out of our custom-built Stefano Ferrara oven. These pizzas are made with only the freshest and highest-quality ingredients, and are cooked to perfection in the wood-fired oven.

In addition to the delicious food and craft beer, Tap Room KL also features a live stage where we showcase some of the best home-grown artists and musicians. This provides a unique and interactive dining experience, as diners can groove along to the live performances while enjoying their food and drinks.

Overall, Tap Room KL is a one-of-a-kind microbrewery experience centre that offers a unique combination of delicious food, craft beer, and live entertainment. It’s a perfect destination for a night out with friends, a casual date, or a special occasion. With a wide range of options available, there’s something for everyone at Tap Room KL.

story: Born from a trip to Bangkok in 1995, Thai Hou Sek has always celebrated the bold, comforting joy of Thai-Chinese pork dishes — full of flavour, fun, and a little cheek.
For 9 years, our 1 Utama crowd has come for the comfort food and cheeky vibes. Now, we’re turning up the heat in SS2.

1 Utama Thai Hou Sek brings a fun twist to Thai-Chinese flavours — serving up bold, porkilicious goodness in a lively, welcoming space. Whether it’s a quick work lunch, a catch-up with friends, dinner with loved ones, or a family gathering, it’s always Hou Sek time here.

SS2 Our first restobar concept, still packed with the same bold flavours, now turned up with ice-cold beers, Mookata grill nights, and late-night Hou Vibes. It’s pork-ilicious soul food by day, and a sizzling pork-and-beer playground by night.
So pull up, chow down, and cheers to good bites and even better nights — because Thai Hou Sek is always Hou Sek, Hou Chill, and Hou Damn Good.

the-attic.tagline: Glow in the dark dance club
story: Taking Yangon’s party scene up a notch, The Attic is a place to see and be seen after the sun sets on Myanmar’s cosmopolitan city. An extension of The Beer Factory, an award-winning bar, The Attic bears all the hallmarks of the brand’s trademark industrial-themed interior. Yet, with its kaleidoscope of UV black lights, glow-in-the-dark wall art and lasers taking centre stage, The Attic maintains an edgy individuality that is second to none in its class.

Amidst this setting, party-goers can partake in The Attic’s pulsating energy brought on by the latest tracks spun out by local and international DJs every weekend. Combined with a fully equipped bar that offers some of the choicest liquors, cocktails and beers, The Attic promises to deliver trendsetters and revellers a raving good time, every night of the week.

tono-izakaya.tagline: Immerse Yourself in Authentic Japanese Izakaya Culture
story: Discover Tono Izakaya Singapore, a vibrant Japanese dining experience nestled in the heart of Marina Bay Financial Centre. Known for its authentic Japanese izakaya atmosphere, Tono Izakaya specializes in expertly grilled yakitori, sashimi, and Japanese-style small plates. Guests are invited to unwind with their signature dishes, including the popular Unagi Don and Engawa Don, crafted with fresh ingredients and grilled over binchotan charcoal for a rich, smoky flavor.

Whether it’s a casual dinner or an after-work gathering, Tono Izakaya offers a cozy, bustling ambiance ideal for both relaxation and enjoyment. Pair your meal with a selection from their curated sake list to fully immerse in the true izakaya spirit, perfect for winding down after a day in the CBD.
